# `xpath`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
xpath(xml, xpath)
```

Returns a string array of values within the nodes of xml that match the XPath expression.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not in the function registry yet |
| Group | `xml_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT xpath('<a><b>b1</b><b>b2</b><b>b3</b><c>c1</c><c>c2</c></a>','a/b/text()');
```

Result:

```text
["b1","b2","b3"]
```

```sql
SELECT xpath('<a><b>b1</b><b>b2</b><b>b3</b><c>c1</c><c>c2</c></a>','a/b');
```

Result:

```text
[null,null,null]
```
